topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Evolution and Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the introductory framing and learning outcomes for the lecture on cancer evolution and the microenvironment.

topics.label: Clonal Selection and Epigenetic Drivers of Tumor Progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how genetic mutations and epigenetic modifications confer selective advantages to clonal populations during cancer development.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and the Cancer Stem Cell Hierarchy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how stem cell properties, tissue hierarchy, and specific cells of origin influence tumor initiation and progression.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Influences on Tumor Outgrowth
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how environmental promoters, inflammatory signaling, and supportive stromal interactions are necessary to drive malignant expansion.

topics.label: Methodologies and the Multi-Factor Cancer Evolution Paradigm
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the advanced profiling technologies used to study tumor heterogeneity and synthesize the unified evolutionary framework of cancer.

topics.label: Conclusion and Upcoming Topics
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding framing and remarks about the following lecture.
